visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Leftover Items Are Dropped
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Merging [1,4,7] with [2,3,9,10] should end with 9 and 10, but the program prints [1,2,3,4,7].

solution.explanation: The loop stops as soon as one array is used up, but the other may still hold items. They are already sorted, so they just have to be appended: slice(i) takes what remains of a, and slice(j) what remains of b.
